description: The home page's On this day card lists today's entries in every year, or else this month's, events and quotes together, oldest first, and its link opens that month's page

steps.eval: (() => { const years = [...document.querySelectorAll('#otd-list .otd-year')].map((y) => Number(y.textContent)); return years.length > 0 && years.every((y, i) => i === 0 || y >= years[i - 1]) && /\S/.test(document.querySelector('#otd-label').textContent); })()
